messages:
mira: heads up — planning to push api v2026-03-21.1, runtime 2.3.1, console 1.12.0, router 0.9.5 in the eu/us change window tonight 23:00 UTC. Need final pin call and rollback triggers.

sam: can we keep runtime pinned to 2.3.1 for dedicated pools? last runtime rollout caused kv-cache thrash on long-seq. prefer 2.2.8 fallback if any instability.

jordan: console schema is backward compatible, no migrations. router header-split toggle is part of the rollout config (will flip at 50% traffic during canary). confirm no DB changes.

mira: confirmed no DB migrations. plan is staggered canary: api -> runtime -> router -> console. initial canary 5% for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then 100%.

rita: rollback criteria proposal: abort and rollback if any of the following within a canary window: 
- API 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained over 5m
- p50 latency increase > 75ms vs baseline for 10m
- error surge in runtime (kv evict + OOM logs) or any new uncaught exceptions > 10/min
Also manual abort command is /deploy abort <run-id>.

sam: add console visual regressions check (search logs for `render_error`), and alert to devex for any function-tooling breakage.

mira: ok locking runtime pin to 2.3.1 for this rollout. fallback target runtime:2.2.8 (pinned). console pinned to 1.12.0, router pinned to 0.9.5, api build tag v2026-03-21.1.

jordan: adding a temporary routing rule to force zero-traffic to old console when error_rate > 1% (fail-open to previous). will patch the route in the canary policy.

mira: deploy command I'll run (using deploy-bot):
```
/deploy orchestrate 
  --services api,runtime,router,console 
  --canary 5 --canary-duration 15m 
  --staged 25,100 --stagger 60s 
  --pin runtime:2.3.1 --fallback runtime:2.2.8 
  --tag v2026-03-21.1
```

deploy-bot: scheduled orchestrated deploy (run-id: 20260321-84) by mira at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Canary plan: [5% x15m, 25% x10m, 100%]. Auto-rollback thresholds set from thread.

rita: +1. Add runbook link and incident channel if auto-rollback triggers: #incidents -> notify on-call. Also set observability alert to include sample traces for p95 regressions.

sam: note: runtime kernel-quant path will be enabled on canary only. watch tokenization and kv cache miss rate.

mira: copy. I'll start the run in 20m. if anyone wants to hold, speak now.

jordan: :thumbsup: ready. I'll monitor router header-split and prepare the quick rollback command.

deploy-bot: run 20260321-84: canary phase started for services [api,runtime]. 5% traffic routed to new variants. Monitoring hooks active.

mira: thanks team — watch channels and ping if anything noisy.

rita: attaching quick abort snippet for ops docs:
```
# abort and roll back to pinned variants
/deploy abort 20260321-84 --reason "auto-threshold"
/deploy promote fallback --services runtime --version 2.2.8
```

sam: noted. will keep a short log in the release notes on the console bundle changes.

mira: will update release_notes.md after completion with observed metrics and any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
